reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: In src/ch.rs, filestate owns cache nodes and optional ordinary FDs; ifile retains its state. The test at 1290-1334 temporarily owns two pipe FDs and allocated states, lending the read FD to CH_KEEPOPEN.
owner_creation.invariant: Cache memory and borrowed stream ownership stay distinct.

aliases_escapes.analysis: In src/ch.rs, raw LRU/hash links, active thisfile and cache data pointers cross native reads and display calls; no borrow checker or generation retires every outside alias.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Cache-node aliases require stable filestate lifetime.

callback_targets.analysis: In src/ch.rs, input, log, diagnostic and close paths call named functions directly; a fatal allocator/display path or handler cleanup can revisit shared state without a retained callback object.
callback_targets.invariant: Direct call dispatch does not prevent owner reentry.

invalidation.analysis: In src/ch.rs, flush marks seekable buffers invalid, navigation can retain nonseekable state, and permanent dispose clears attachments before freeing nodes/state.
invalidation.invariant: Flush, navigation-close and permanent deletion differ.

mutation_commit.analysis: In src/ch.rs, ch_addbuf initializes and links a calloc node; first-buffer failure stops before casting the sentinel. Raw multi-link updates still lack one owning transaction.
mutation_commit.invariant: An empty sentinel cannot be published as a buf payload.

release_pair.analysis: In src/ch.rs, calloc/free retire nodes; owned FD close occurs once while borrowed stdin/pipe/help have separate owners. The test frees states through disposal, closes both pipe ends on success and restores thisfile.
release_pair.invariant: Input cleanup must not close borrowed standard streams.

error_cleanup.analysis: In src/ch.rs, read/log/allocation failures have separate state and sticky latches; passing guards alone cannot establish every caller diagnostic, exit status or reentrant cleanup contract.
error_cleanup.invariant: Local error guards cannot close end-to-end findings.

signals_handoff.analysis: In src/ch.rs, signal polling does not exclude a handler that enters allocator, output or cleanup during linked-state mutation; broad core ownership remains open.
signals_handoff.invariant: Cache lifetime still needs ordinary owner-controlled dispatch.
limitations: Current first-buffer, stdin-disposal and log-write fixes remain improvements, not closed findings. The unit test closes its manual FD resources only on its successful path; assertion failure lacks RAII FD rollback.

src/signal.rs.relationship: Handlers may enter output, filter/queue mutation or cleanup while the reviewed ordinary owner has live aliases. Target: FILE:src/ch.rs.
